title: ProgressionNetworkChat
description: Cross-server chat syncing for Velocity networks—one community, no split chat.
body:
# ProgressionNetworkChat

If your server runs multiple backends, chat often splits your community. ProgressionNetworkChat fixes that by syncing messages across the network, so it feels like one connected server. Players stay together socially, even when gameplay is separated.

# Highlights:

Network-wide chat synchronization for multi-server setups

Built for Velocity-based networks

Keeps community conversation unified

Perfect for: networks, multi-mode servers, shared communities.

# Why you’ll love it

Your network feels like one connected server

Community stays together across multiple backends

Eliminates “server chat silos”

# Features

Network-wide chat synchronization

Designed for Velocity + backend servers

Clean, stable cross-server messaging

# Setup

Install on Velocity + required backends (as intended)

Configure shared secret/network settings

Restart and test cross-server chat

# Compatibility

Platform: Velocity + Paper backends (depending on your setup)

Intended for multi-server networks
